name: Public Bank Berhad

source.title: Public Bank quarterly report Q3 FY2026

oneLine: Malaysia's second-largest lender, focused on home, car and small-business loans, with a large unit-trust business (Public Mutual).
inPlainWords: Public Bank is a retail-focused bank: most of its lending is mortgages, hire purchase (car loans) and loans to small and medium businesses.
About 95% of its loans are in Malaysia; it also operates in Hong Kong and Cambodia.
Its unit-trust arm, Public Mutual, earns fees on savings invested in funds.
It is known for having one of the lowest shares of bad loans in the industry.

flow.label: Depositors
flow.detail: Customers place savings and deposits with the bank, which pays them interest.

flow.label: The bank
flow.detail: It lends that money out as home, car, personal and business loans at a higher rate.

flow.label: Borrowers
flow.detail: Borrowers repay with interest; the gap between the two rates is the bank's main income.

flow.label: Fees
flow.detail: It also earns fees from cards, wealth products, insurance sales and transactions.

segments.name: Retail operations
segments.desc: Home loans, deposits, cards and loans to small businesses

segments.name: Overseas operations
segments.desc: Banking in Hong Kong and Cambodia

segments.name: Fund management (Public Mutual)
segments.desc: Unit trusts sold to Malaysian savers

segments.name: Treasury, capital markets and investment banking
segments.desc: Bond trading, money markets and deal advice

segmentNote: Revenue is net income (after paying depositors); profit is profit before tax by segment (Q3 FY2026 report p.46). Third-quarter 2026 figures; the report gives the segment split for the quarter.
